findings.trigger: Initialize a recovered mixed-review run in closing phase; retrying its exact close or durable acknowledgement fails transiently
findings.expected: Retain the exact pending close and expose an actionable completion retry even though no question prompt has been restored
findings.actual: _complete sets completionRetryRequired and rethrows, then initialize catch overwrites phase with failed. UI displays a fixed failure message without retry. Merely preserving the retry phase is insufficient because _retryControls is nested inside the nonnull prompt branch and recovered closing run has no prompt
findings.proposedRegression: Real checkpointed recovered closing session with one transient finish or acknowledgement failure: visible retry succeeds using same terminal identity, one canonical completion, and no new answer evidence; test controller phase and widget with null prompt

findings.trigger: Recover an authenticated unfinished Pair session after owner merge; plan retains original owner while runtimeOwnerId is current custodian; acknowledge a correct match with animations enabled
findings.expected: Transient feedback expires for the same live runtime owner/session so completed result becomes visible without changing historical plan identity
findings.actual: _presentAccepted adds feedback episodes, but timer current() compares _liveOwner to after.plan.ownerId. Those differ for valid migrated recovery, so neither fade nor removal executes. Result UI waits for _feedbackEpisodes.isEmpty, leaving completed board displayed
findings.proposedRegression: Real migrated-owner Pair recovery with retained original plan: finish final match, advance feedback hold/fade, assert result visible and original plan/evidence actor history unchanged; owner replacement still cancels stale feedback

findings.trigger: Last item is skipped because reviewed content is missing/stale/ambiguous; finishing the session fails

findings.proposedRegression: Widget tests for definition and cloze with last skipped item and finish failing once: exact retry visible and succeeds, no answer evidence inserted, stable captured terminal intent and no duplicate completion

No live email/provider needed.

findings.trigger: Open production Vocabulary tab, push a personal category and AddWordScreen, then emergencyOff Feature.vocabulary while editor remains on Navigator stack; submit a valid new word
findings.expected: Withdrawal disables the open vocabulary route and rejects any newly initiated mutation through retained UI callbacks
findings.actual: MainNavigation gates only CategoriesPage. CategoriesPage pushes bare VocabListScreen, which pushes bare editor/import routes. AppNavigator.pushPage directly builds MaterialPageRoute with no feature wrapper. Editor/usecases/repository ordinary create path has no live feature check; parent gate rebuild cannot remove sibling Navigator routes, so a new word and outbox write remain admissible after withdrawal. Existing widget tests do not toggle registry on these pushed routes.
findings.proposedRegression: Real Drift + production RuntimeFeatureRegistry widget: open category/editor through actual Navigator, retain submit callback, emergency-off vocabulary, invoke stale callback and verify zero word/outbox additions; positive enabled counterpart and import descendant. Bind every descendant to same explicit parent registry and fence new mutations without interrupting already committed writes. Reproduce in G8.3, no live services.

findings.trigger: Category revision1 commits remotely but its ACK is lost; local category edited to revision2 before expired operation1 is replayed; also SRS revision1 remote commit followed by a second recorded review before replay
findings.expected: Replay validates and records original remote receipt without losing later edit, then sends revision2 exactly once
findings.actual: claimPending preserves attempted operation1 ID but _reconstructMutation uses current category.localRevision2. FirestoreSyncCodec.decodeAcknowledgement requires receipt resultingRevision equal expectedMutation.localRevision, so real revision1 receipt throws InvalidSyncPayloadFailure. Existing file-backed regression bypasses codec: _IdempotentFakeCloud returns saved PushAcknowledged directly and store accepts it. Thus regression does not cover production gateway rejection; later pull may resolve newer local edit as cloudWins. Cross-check learning_event_sync_test lost-SRS-ACK fixture explicitly expects replay localRevision2 and saved ACK1 through _SrsIdempotentFakeCloud, confirming the same mismatch for real recordAnswer-produced SRS work.
findings.proposedRegression: File-backed lost-ACK first category commit using actual FirestoreSyncCodec.encodeOperation/decodeAcknowledgement in gateway fixture, edit through actual repository then reopen/replay through SyncEngine; original receipt accepted with no second first operation write and later edit delivered. Preserve exact receipt identity validation and add first-send-never-committed positive case; do not weaken mismatch checks. Include SRS via actual recordAnswer plus reopen, using the same real codec boundary and preserving immutable answer evidence/projection authority.

findings.trigger: Bounded proof candidate page begins with limit-many structurally eligible opportunities that fail current source/permit admission, while later opportunities have valid current authority. Repeated preparation starts with absent or unchanged local cursor.
findings.expected: Later independently authorized proofs are eventually inspected within bounded work, without admitting denied facts or weakening no-unauthorized-persistence rules.
findings.actual: Candidate SQL sorts opportunity ID/phase and limits before authority validation. Every denied candidate continues without setting frontier; scheduling cursor writes only after admitted frontier. Repeated calls can reread the same entirely denied page forever. Existing 50-ACK progress test uses admitted rows and does not cover denied-prefix starvation. Other research collection enqueue queries likewise bound before allowed checks, so related scope needs RED confirmation.
findings.proposedRegression: Synthetic local real-Drift fixture with limit1 denied leading opportunity and separately valid later opportunity, repeat bounded preparation and recreate repository; later valid proof/outbox must appear, denied evidence/ACK/consent must remain unchanged. Preserve all-denied no-cursor-write, rollout-off, owner-fence, finite scan and late-withdrawal invariants; no live research activity. Confirm intended no-write authority constraints before selecting local scheduling design; do not simply persist denial as authorization.

findings.trigger: An active reply is draining cancellation while removeKey() or updateConsents(providerConsent:false) is awaiting _cancelActiveOperations(); another reply enters the same live controller before the revoke mutation is queued.
findings.expected: Revocation reserves ordering immediately so newly arriving replies cannot use the credential being revoked; already accepted operations drain without weakening owner/lease or paid-result accounting.
findings.actual: Live AiTutorUseCases queues the mutation only after awaited drain, allowing the new reply to reserve _transitionGate first and escape the cancellation snapshot. Legacy Gemini controller already has explicit regression for this sequence and reserves transition before draining. Production bootstrap instantiates AiTutorUseCases; settings calls its revoke/remove methods. Current settings page has local saving guard but shared controller boundary is still callable. Runtime confirmation pending.
findings.proposedRegression: Deferred cancellation-aware provider, actual AiTutorUseCases with unique operation/event IDs and actual secure/Drift fenced composition where practical: start replyA; request remove/revoke; synchronously submit replyB during drain; releaseA; assert only one provider generation and replyB blocked, credential revoked, pending/terminal records truthful. Repeat for both operations; preserve paid-completed-result and lease-loss oracles.

findings.actual: Gateway calls (value*1000000).round() inside _parseUsage before returning AiGatewayReply; only FormatException is caught by _parseReply. Later use-case _sanitizedUsage protects invalid AiTokenUsage values but cannot recover a gateway parse exception before reply exists. Current rawHTTP fixtures cover normalcost12micros only. Runtime JSON/nonfinite behavior reproduction pending.
findings.proposedRegression: Real gateway decoder with synthetic rawJSON containing validchoices/text and cost1e308; assert reply survives, badcostnull, oneHTTP request, then actualusecase completion success with truthful unknown accounting. Retainfinitepositive/zero/negative/typeinvalid counter tests and limits; no provider network.
